verdicts.reason: A breaks up the hierarchy. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk and left floating on a decorative circle, the logo and bottle sit off on separate sides, and the subcopy, CTA and legal text are crammed into one bottom row with the legal text inside a circle, so the eye has no clear path. B keeps the original's centred order and branding but has an orphaned 'last' in the headline, a tiny logo and bottle in too much empty space, very small legal text, and subcopy running over the edge of the big background circle.
